title: チューリップ賞にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tulip Sho arrives. Vodka was nervous at the Hanshin J.F., but this time she's calm, with both feet firmly planted on the ground.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Vodka thanks me for easing her fears. She's embarrassed to admit that Daiwa Scarlet also had a helping effect.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Finally standing in the starting grid, Vodka faces the race ahead, ready for the real beginning.
